# refd

> Open-source monitoring for AI search. refd tracks how often your brand is mentioned and cited in AI answers — across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overviews — and shows how you compare to the competitors you track.

refd runs your buyer questions across AI answer surfaces on a schedule, then
scores each answer for brand mentions, source citations, first-mention position,
and share of voice. Every raw answer is stored, so any metric can be traced back
to the exact answer it came from. Use the hosted app at refd.ai or self-host the
full stack on your own Cloudflare and Bright Data accounts. Bright Data is the
only data provider, and nothing phones home.

## Docs
- [Homepage](https://refd.ai/index.md): what refd does and who it is for
- [Full overview for LLMs](https://refd.ai/llms-full.txt): the complete product description in one file
- [Source code](https://github.com/emaitchess/refd): the entire stack, open source on GitHub
- [Design system](https://github.com/emaitchess/refd/blob/main/DESIGN.md): UI and charting guidelines

## Product

- [Answer surfaces](https://refd.ai/): ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overviews
- [Create an account](https://refd.ai/auth/create-account): start tracking a brand
- [Sign in](https://refd.ai/auth/sign-in): return to your workspace
